layers.name: Description pinning
layers.mechanism: Hash-pin each tool description at startup; quarantine any tool whose description changes mid-run and deny calls to it.

layers.name: IBAN allowlist
layers.mechanism: A payment request may only target an IBAN registered to a known payee or the operating account.

layers.name: Approval gating
layers.mechanism: execute_payment and update_payee_bank_details are denied without an explicit human approval token.

layers.name: Egress filter
layers.mechanism: Email to a non-internal domain is denied, as is any email or chat message carrying IBAN-shaped data.

layers.name: Untrusted-content scan
layers.mechanism: Document output is scanned for injection patterns, tagged with provenance, and wrapped in a quarantine banner before the model reads it.
